entries.principle_source: OECD AI Principles (2019, amended 2024), principle 1.4; non-binding recommendation
entries.instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 230-VIII of 17 November 2025 'On Artificial Intelligence'
entries.provision: Art. 18, part 2 (risk management) and Art. 8, part 1 (constant control of the system)
entries.why_here: In Part 4 the bare agent gave a decision for impossible values (GPA 9.9, exam -5); the check stops them before the model.

entries.principle_source: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence (2021), principle on fairness and non-discrimination; non-binding
entries.instrument: Constitution of the Republic of Kazakhstan (1995) and Law No. 94-V 'On Personal Data and their Protection'
entries.provision: Constitution Art. 14 (equality, no discrimination); Law No. 94-V Art. 7, part 9 (no excessive data)
entries.why_here: In Part 1 my measurement found score changes when only the name or university changed; name and university are not merit, so the model does not see them.

entries.principle: Respect for human rights and privacy
entries.principle_source: OECD AI Principles (2019, amended 2024), principle 1.2; non-binding recommendation
entries.instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 94-V of 21 May 2013 'On Personal Data and their Protection'
entries.provision: Art. 7, part 1 (consent) and part 8 (specific lawful purposes); Art. 8 (consent)
entries.why_here: In Part 4 the bare agent decided a wrong purpose, a 17-year-old, no consent and an instruction in the name; the harness refused 5 of 6 and refused 0 of 400 clean applicants.

entries.principle_source: OECD AI Principles (2019, amended 2024), principle 1.5; non-binding recommendation
entries.instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 230-VIII of 17 November 2025 'On Artificial Intelligence'
entries.provision: Art. 8, part 1 (responsibility and control); EU benchmark only: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 Art. 12(1)
entries.why_here: The log keeps field names and not values, so a person can see later why a decision was made, including the refusals of Part 4.

entries.principle_source: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence (2021), principle on human oversight and determination; non-binding
entries.instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 230-VIII of 17 November 2025 'On Artificial Intelligence'
entries.provision: Art. 7, part 2 (right to object to automated processing); EU benchmark only: GDPR Art. 22(3)
entries.why_here: Scores are close near the threshold, so 50 of 400 profiles (12.5%) in the band 40 to 45 go to a person.
